title: My Sister Forged a Codicil, Erased My Inheritance, and Sold Mom's Theater. So I Voided the Sale
description: At 59, after 26 years as a home-health aide, I came home to care for my dying mother, who left me 70% of her 1940s single-screen theater and projection equipment worth $610,000. My sister forged a codicil, sold the property to a multiplex chain for $890,000, and mailed me a $4,600 concession check. I found Mom's original will inside a hollow carbon-arc film reel canister, voided the sale, and now run Flicker of Deceit Cinema, where every ticket stub prints her probate-fraud docket number. #InheritanceBetrayal #ProbateFraud #MovieTheater
thumb_text: SHE FORGED MOM'S WILL, I VOIDED THE SALE
pinned_comment: If your sister forged a codicil, sold your mom's $890,000 theater, and mailed you a $4,600 concession check, what would you have done the moment that original will slid out of the reel canister? Tell me your move or share your own family betrayal story in the comments.

thumb_lines.text: SHE MAILED ME A $4,600 CONCESSION CHECK AND THOUGHT I'D VANISH
